output.summary: MAS opened a stablecoin consultation on 1 Sept (closes 16 Oct) with clarifications for banks; its bank corporate governance paper came 30 Sept, outside the period.

sources.title: MAS Consults on Legislative Amendments to Implement Stablecoin Regulatory Framework
sources.quote: MAS consults on legislative amendments to implement stablecoin regulatory framework; feedback due 16 October 2026

sources.title: Singapore: MAS Introduces Stablecoins Framework under Payments Legislation
sources.quote: clarifications for banks, merchant banks and wholesale banks that intend to issue stablecoins

sources.title: Singapore's Proposed Stablecoin Rules: What the MAS Consultation Means for Issuers, Exchanges, and Banks
sources.quote: Banks may only issue a MAS-regulated stablecoin through a separate non-bank entity.
